name: directory
title: Archdiocese of Newark parish finder
command: pnpm diocese roster import newark directory scratch/newark-map-1/001-survey/directory.json
notes: Scraped 2026-11-03 by scratch/newark-map-1/tools/rcan_directory.py from the page's plPlaces JSON (name, address, coordinates) and its parish cards (website, language tags, search aliases). 218 entries, all kind 'parish': one per canonical parish, not per church. Parishes merged into one share an address (Immaculate Conception and Our Lady of Good Counsel, Newark). 24 cards have no website link.
